name: GLONASS
best_known_for: Russia's GNSS — 24 active satellites at 19,130 km MEO / 64.8° inclination / 3 planes; first operational GNSS outside GPS; full coverage restored 2011 after 1990s collapse
credit: Roscosmos GLONASS programme. First launched 1982; collapsed in the 1990s post-Soviet funding crisis; restored to 24-satellite operational status 2011.
